title: Price the plane-port repair against the naive charge 224
body:
## Summary
- The line-port repair `X_q` delivers `C_all`. Replacing the line by a plane delivers `C_all` on both plane coordinates. A dirty spectator stays at exponent 2, and omitting the repair misses the endpoint.
- The ideal unpaid=2 ceiling ratio rounds to the published 3.77. The naive charge 224 has deficit `-224/9`, and the ceiling rejects a positive saving.
- The selected exponent is unchanged.
